documents.title: Summit Classic HMO Annual Notice of Change 2027
documents.body_markdown:
## Important changes for 2027

- **Provider network.** Alder Heart Associates, including its Northside and Lakeview offices, will no longer be in the Summit Classic HMO network starting January 1, 2027. If you see a doctor in this group, you will need a new in-network cardiologist or a different plan to keep seeing them at in-network cost.
- **Specialist visits.** Your specialist copay for 2027 is $40.
- **Premium.** Your monthly plan premium stays at $0.

You can change plans during the Annual Election Period, October 15 through December 7.
